purpose: Animated people for all nine study scenes (user request, October 2026): realistic diverse scans (Nathan and Carla) with distinct appearances and skin tones, rendered from licensed Renderpeople scans with original textures (no skin recoloring). Strips cover hero backyard crossing with walk-then-chat transition, plus interior seated and standing conversation/idle profiles across all scenes.
licence_use: Free Renderpeople models downloaded directly, no purchase or account. The terms permit rendering for commercial and private use; the raw model data (FBX, textures, .blend) is never redistributed, so it stays in research-people and is not part of the website, Git or any package. Only rendered output is published.
